573)smi'i gling rgyal brngan gtong lugs ni/spyan 'dren sngon bskal ma'i mgor/thang gcigazil/dgra 'don/sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/o rgyan yul gyi=

tei:div.tei:p: smi'i gling rgyal brngan gtong lugs ni/ spyan 'dren sngon bskal ma'i mgor/ thang gcig zil/ (Musical notes and signs here) dgra 'don/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ o rgyan yul gyi= mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ thang gcig sngar bzhin/ sngags/ zil/ bzhag rol/ sngags mchod lan gsum mthar/ thang gcig zil/ bsang rol dgu rdung bstod pa dgra 'don kyis/ mthar/ thang gcig zil/ bzhag bsnyen pa sag mdun bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ thang gsum/ zil/ bsang 'don gyis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= sogs/ mthar/ thang gcig zil/ bzhag mdun bskyed/ 'phags pa'i tshogs las= sogs/ lhug mchod yon me tog sogs mgo rol med/ bsang 'don/ mthar/ thang gcig zil/ bzhag rol/ mgron drug gtor 'bul/ gzhi bdag gtor 'bul/ bsang dngos la/ mchod pa/ du ba byin rlabs 'phros/ thang gsum/ zil/ gdangs btang na/ thang gcig (Musical notes and signs here) e ma= sogs dang*/ gdangs ma btang na/ dgu rdung snga ma lta bu'i bsang 'don shar rgyag gdangs btang tshe/ bka' bsgros nas/ thang gcig gdangs rol sngar ltar/ 'di man gyi tshig mgor rtse len med/ de min 'dra/ lag len byas pas tham cad dag par gsungs/ zhes pa'i mtshams rol mo med/ bsang gi cho gas legs par 'grub par shog rol mtshams/ e ma= sogs/ mthu dpung sdong grogs byed pa'i srung ma bsang*/ rol mtshams/ bdag cag 574) dpon slob= sogs/ phyi nang lha srin sde brgyad mthu chen bsang*/ rol mtshams/ khams gsum= sogs/ mthar/ zil/ sum gnyis/ mnol bsang*/ ri bo bsang mchod gnyis lhug 'don nam/ dgra 'don gang rung*/ lhug tshe mthar/ sum ya zil/ bsang rol/ bsang 'don gyis/ bla ma yi dam= sogs/ 'dod rgu'i re ba skong du gsol/ thang gcig nas/ bsang rol/ mchod yon me tog= sogs/ bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs mdzod/ mtsham rol/ dus gsum sangs rgyas= sogs/ bsang 'don/ bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs mdzod/ bsang rol dgu rdung mthar/ zil/ bzhag

gsol ka dngos rol mchod rlabs nas skabs bstun gyis bstod pa'i mthar skong ba de mtshungs mthar/ bshags pa de mtshungs/ lha chen bshags pa'i mjug nas/ sum ya/ zil/ tshogs grol na bzhag rol/ ma grol na bsang rol gyis/ dgra bla/ tshogs grol skabs/ dgra bla'i mgo rol/ thang gsum/ zil/ bsang rol yin/ dgra bla'i mthar/ rlung rta/ lha bzhi/ lha lnga/ rjes 'brang nas/ zhing skyong sogs skabs bstun/ thang lha/ gter bdag dang*/ gzhi bdag mthar/ spyi bshags/ rang bzhin chos dbyings= sogs/ sum ya/ zil/ bzhag tshar gsog ji dgos 'don/ slar yang*/ srid rgyal ma/ rtsi dmar/ spyi bshags rang bzhin chos dbyings mthar/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ gser skyems/ mthar/ sum/ zil/ bzhag gtor ma sngags 'bul mthar/ thang gsum/ zil/ sum gnyis/ bskul pa'i rigs rnams 'don/ 575) mthar/ sum gnyis/ phrin bcol/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung= mthar/ sum ya/ zil/ thing*/ bsang rol/ thang*/ (Musical notes and signs here) zad/ yul ni rdo rje'i brag dmar gyi// sring gcig gangs dkar sha med ma// bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan/ (Musical notes and signs here) thang/ (Musical notes and signs here) nas/ lhu re'i gsum mtshams/ mtshams rol re re bya/ bod yul kun gyi= man bsang 'don/ mtshams so sor bsang rol/ bde legs mdzod/ thang bzhi/ zil bzhag tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma'i bar btang*/ gtor 'gugs med/ sngags 'bul/ gtor 'bul bkra shis bar/ bsang gzhung*/ ma 'byor pa dang= nas/ bkra shis mthar/ zhi rol/ ༈ bsang gtor ni/ bsang stegs kyi dbus bsang bshos bang rim bzhi pa'i steng*/ bla gtor dkar po pad zlum can gyi rtags bzhir/ mgrin bzhi la gtor chung bzhi re/ zur bzhi so so'i thad nas/ brtan ma'i gtor ma dmar po/ mtheb ril can gyi lto bar gshog rnyog byas pa'i rnying mtshan bzhi re drang por bsgrigs pa/ de'i mdun du brngan bcu dgu la/ dkar zlum theb ril can bcu dgu gral stabs su bkod pa/

de'i mdun du gsol ka'i gtor ma legs ldan nas/ bdud btsan klu gsum bar gyi gtor ma rnams rim par ma 'chol bar bsgrigs/ de'i g.yon du gzhi bdag la dkar gtor/ g.yas su gter bdag la dmar gtor mtheb skyu can/ de'i mdun g.yas 576) su/ dkar zlum theb ril can gsum gyi mtshams gnyis su 'phrang rgyas phyed dkar phyed nag gri ris gnyis kyi mtshams phyes pa gnyis/ dkar zlum gsum gyi mtheb ril steng mar gyi g.yag lug ra gsum gyi mgos mtshan pa/ dkon mchog spyi la dmar gtor theb skyu/ chos skyong spyi la dmar gtor theb skyu can/ gtsang ris spyi la/ dkar gtor gcig yul spyi la dkar gtor gcig 'byung po spyi la bgegs gtor dkar po/ de dag gi mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gang bder/ gzugs 'gros sna tshogs gzhung nas byung ba ltar/
